notes.title: DevLog Update #12
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone!
[/p][p]After the previous playtest I wasn't happy with the way flying works. I've implemented the point and click mechanism because it was easier but at the end it was not engaging and challenging at all. I've always wanted to make the game as engaging and accessible as possible so I've decided to change it so that you can manually fly your ship instead of just clicking in a RTS style. This means more fun flying around, more challenges and dangers but most importantly this opens a possibility to implement controller support. Check out the latest update video linked below.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="ZmZzojr9aww;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Big changes are coming to how you explore the stars!
notes.content:
Hello explorers!

Over the past few weeks, I’ve been focused on making space exploration more thrilling and less about drifting aimlessly through the void. You spoke, I listened: no more wandering around empty space hoping to stumble on something cool. Now, you’ll be able to scout the map before you even leave the station!

That’s right, points of interest are now visible before takeoff. Once you're out there, you’ll be able to scan mysterious locations in real-time, but there's a twist: scanning requires precision, and you won’t immediately know what you've found. Is it treasure? A trap? Gateway to the unknown or something... alive?

Don’t worry, you’ll unlock new talents that improve your scanning skills and give you the edge in identifying what lies beyond the stars.

Enough talk, check out my latest DevLog video and see the new system in action!

[previewyoutube=c95uA7HDgKM;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Your voice have been heard - check the latest DevLog update!
Open Beta Summary
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

It has been almost one week since the open beta was closed. I've received enough quality feedback from players and I want to say thank you! I want you to know that your opinion means a lot to me and I'm going to address the issues you've mentioned to make the game more entertaining. In the next few days I will be working on preparing the roadmap which I want to share with everyone. There is a plenty of features coming so stay tuned for further updates.

notes.title: Void Harvest - open beta is now available!
notes.content:
Greetings explorers!

This beta offers a small slice of the full experience, but there's already plenty to dive into:

[list]
[*]Explore one playable map filled with dangers and discoveries.
[*]Mine asteroids, some are unstable and will explode if you're not careful.
[*]Search and scan abandoned debris to uncover hidden blueprints.
[*]Level up your character, earn skill points, and experiment with a limited talent tree.
[*]Refine ore and craft a functional shield module.
[*]Equip the shield to protect yourself while mining and surviving the void.
[/list]

Your feedback will help shape what’s next. Jump in now and let me know what you think!

This test will run for two weeks, starting [b]April 11th at 6PM CET[/b] and ending [b]April 28th at 9AM CET[/b].

[u][b]You can leave feedback directly in-game via a Google Form – it really means the world to me and helps shape the future of the project. I’ve also set up a Discord channel, where you can report bugs, share thoughts, or just hang out and chat about the game.[/b][/u]

notes.title: Void Harvest – Open playtest dates & info
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
I’ve been working on this space survival game for a while now, and I’m finally ready (and a little nervous) to open the first technical playtest to the public! This is a huge moment for me, and I’d love your help testing how the game runs on different setups.

This playtest only shows a small slice of the full experience. Here’s what you’ll be able to do:

🌌 Explore one playable map.
🪨 Mine asteroids, some are unstable and will destroy you.
🚀 Search abandoned debris, scan them, and uncover hidden blueprints.
🧠 Level up, earn skill points, and access a limited talent tree.
⚙️ Refine ore and craft a shield module using what you discover.
🛡️ Equip the shield to protect yourself while mining.

This test will run for two weeks, starting [b]April 11th at 6PM CET[/b] and ending [b]April 28th at 9AM CET[/b].

💬 You can leave feedback directly in-game via a Google Form – it really means the world to me and helps shape the future of the project.

💬 I’ve also set up a Discord channel, where you can report bugs, share thoughts, or just hang out and chat about the game.

I’m super excited to see what you think. Thanks for being part of this early journey!
